title: Presheaf extension from a field preserves monomorphisms
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X a topological space, R a sheaf of possibly noncommutative rings, and alpha:k -> R(X). The identity-site presheaf pullback for the map [def-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-ring-map], whose existence is [lem-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-pullback-exists], preserves monomorphisms of constant-k module presheaves, in every carrier universe Type(max u v). This statement concerns presheaves only; it asserts no sheafification or injective preservation.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Tags 0095 and 0096; Modules, Tag 02N4. Canonical online tag pages consulted; noncommutative presheaf construction and universe bookkeeping made explicit by M2.

proof.text: Use [def-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-ring-map] and the right-adjoint instance from [lem-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-pullback-exists]. Apply [lem-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-pullback-evaluation] to obtain, on each open U, a natural isomorphism between evaluated presheaf pullback and evaluation followed by the balanced scalar-extension functor of [def-pod-ring-scalar-extension].

Every monomorphism of k-vector spaces has a linear retraction, by Mathlib LinearMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective and ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective. Applying any functor to that retraction gives a split monomorphism. The private proved helper fieldModuleFunctor_preservesMonomorphisms implements this for any functor out of ModuleCat k. Thus ordinary balanced scalar extension preserves monomorphisms. Presheaf evaluation preserves monos; transport this preservation along the comparison using Functor.PreservesMonomorphisms.of_iso. ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective and PresheafOfModules.mono_of_injective then show that the whole presheaf pullback map is mono. Retractions are chosen independently at each open; no natural retraction of presheaves is asserted or needed. The argument includes zero modules, zero section rings and empty X.

from.place: The scalar-restricted injective-resolution comparison in the field-linear cohomology argument: Presheaf extension from a field preserves monomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem fieldScalarPresheafPullback_preservesMonomorphisms
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (X : TopCat.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u})
    (α : k →+* R.obj.obj (op ⊤)) :
    letI := fieldScalarPresheafPullback_isRightAdjoint.{u, v} X R α
    (PresheafOfModules.pullback.{max u v}
      (fieldScalarPresheafRingMap X R α)).PreservesMonomorphisms
